name: program-runtime.optimize
purpose: Submit one immutable optimization request to the durable owner engine, wait once for a bounded interval, and return its pending or terminal receipt.

request.description: Complete immutable optimization.Request object with stable run_id, owner target id, subject, candidates, suite_id, fixed case_ids, and minimum_cases. The registered target adapter validates target-specific shape; Ollama role runs use an authoritative role name, three candidates pinned to expected artifact digests, and 20+ cases, while desktop-startup pins DP1's paired denominator.

wait_ms.description: One bounded wait after submit, from 1 to 60000 milliseconds. A pending response remains durable and can be resumed later.

assumptions: The request names a registered owner adapter and pins every candidate and evaluation case before owner effects begin.

Request keys follow the optimization.Request JSON contract exactly; the LM6 showcase uses three chat.default candidates pinned to their expected owner-policy artifact digests and at least 20 fixed cases, and the Ollama owner adapter may accept other authoritative roles for LM8. Desktop-startup pins one candidate digest and 30 distinct class-phase-pair case IDs. Other lower-case target IDs are delegated to a registered owner adapter, which must validate the target-specific contract before effects.
The engine owns durable run identity, recovery, rights and disk admission, promotion, cleanup, and refusal; this program does not recreate those policies.
Target adapters obtain facts and effects through their owning resource or scenario APIs; this program never shells out or calls a private CLI command.
A single wait can return pending; the optimizer continues under its durable owner and a later invocation resumes by the same immutable run_id.
invariants: The envelope is printed exactly once on every path.
The request must be a valid optimization.Request object with a non-empty stable run_id before submit is called.
Submit is called at most once and Wait is called at most once per program invocation; the program never polls.
A pending result is reported as partial with the same run_id and is not presented as a winner or completed optimization.
Only an owner record with stage complete is reported as ok; a refused owner record stays refused.
All model acquisition, evaluation, rights, disk, promotion, and deletion decisions remain in governed owner boundaries.
No target-specific effect runs unless a matching owner adapter is registered; unknown owner targets fail closed.

bindings.note: Starts or resumes one immutable durable optimization run; each downstream side effect remains gated by owner receipts.
If the one bounded wait is unavailable, return the submitted durable record as pending so a later invocation can resume it.

status.note: partial means the durable owner run remains pending after the single bounded wait.

signals.waited_ms: Time spent in the single bounded owner wait, in milliseconds.
signals.winner_id: Owner accepted winner, when promotion completed.
signals.failure: Owner refusal or failure reason, when present.
signals.last_error: Most recent retryable owner error, when the durable run is pending.
signals.retry_at: Owner-scheduled retry time for a pending run.
signals.stage_attempts: Bounded per-stage retry counts recorded by the durable manager.
signals.candidate_artifact_digests: Acquisition receipt mapping of every pinned candidate ID to its acquired artifact digest.
signals.candidate_results: Evaluation receipt results keyed by candidate ID, with each owner's case count, case digest, and score.
signals.promoted_artifact_digest: Exact pinned artifact digest named by the promotion receipt.
signals.removal_receipts: Cleanup owner receipts keyed by every losing candidate and predecessor ID.
signals.receipts: Bounded list of stage and owner receipt IDs from the durable record.

outputs.evidence: Durable owner receipt IDs, one entry per returned evidence stage.

fixtures.note: Exercises local request validation before any optimizer binding or owner operation.
